If BRITANNIA tracks these three closely, the weakness is likely an industry/staples repricing tied to leadership uncertainty and near-term demand expectations.

The sentiment backdrop is bullish, with broker upgrades and top-pick mentions consistent with a cyclical materials rally; in that environment, cement and building-material leaders can act as leading demand proxies for steel. GRASIM is both a graph neighbor and one of the strongest 60d/120d rolling-correlation names, while ULTRACEMCO also ranks highly in rolling correlations and belongs to the same broad materials cycle. JSWSTEEL anchors the basket to the steel industry itself. This exact style has also been the best prior successful family for TATASTEEL, so it is a strong demand-led alternative to the input-cost basket.
